desc: Parse the input grid and build label-grouped incoming/outgoing adjacency (pred[c][u], succ[c][v]) plus base distance initialization (diagonal 0, direct edges 1, else unreachable).

Implement the core pair-state BFS: enqueue all diagonals (level 0) then all single edges (level 1), then relax each state (u,v) by matching label c with p in pred[c][u] and q in succ[c][v], setting dist[p][q] = dist[u][v] + 2.
Bound runtime for N <= 100 using bitmask succ[c][v] and per-left-endpoint vis masks to avoid rescanning the full Cartesian product.
Preserve the diagonal 0 (never overwrite with self-loop) and output the matrix rows space-separated, converting unreachable entries to -1.
Verify on both public samples (both PASSED).
